facts.content: Patient presents with upper lip swelling after eating prawn soup.
facts.source_text: CC: Upper lip swelling after prawn soup (~30 min post-ingestion); worsening

facts.content: Upper lip swelling began approximately 30 minutes after ingestion of prawn soup and has been worsening.
facts.source_text: CC: Upper lip swelling after prawn soup (~30 min post-ingestion); worsening

facts.content: The swelling started at the left corner and progressed to involve the upper lip, described as pulsatile.
facts.source_text: Sx: Left corner → upper lip swelling; pulsatile

facts.content: Patient reports not being able to breathe that well.
Patient reports chest feeling tight and breathing being difficult.
The patient ate the prawn soup at approximately 1900 after work.
About one year ago the patient had a similar reaction after a late-night Chinese curry, waking with swelling and difficult breathing.
facts.source_text: Prior similar: ~1 yr ago after late-night Chinese curry; woke swollen with difficult breathing

facts.content: Patient has a history of asthma.
Patient has a peanut allergy with a reported childhood severe reaction requiring a prior hospital visit and injection.
facts.source_text: Allergies: Peanut (childhood severe reaction; per mother, prior hospital visit and injection)

facts.content: The patient lives with or is currently staying with her mother, who is available to provide antihistamines.
Suspected anaphylaxis after prawn exposure characterized by progressive lip angioedema and shortness of breath with history of peanut allergy and a prior similar reaction.
facts.source_text: 1) Suspected anaphylaxis after prawn exposure: progressive lip angioedema + SOB; hx peanut allergy; prior similar reaction

facts.content: Call 999 for immediate emergency medical services or emergency department assessment for suspected anaphylaxis.
facts.source_text: • Call 999 for immediate EMS/ED assessment for suspected anaphylaxis

facts.content: Patient is advised to take any available antihistamine while awaiting emergency medical services.
facts.source_text: • Take available antihistamine while awaiting EMS

facts.content: Patient is advised not to be alone and for her mother to stay with her and call 999.
facts.source_text: • Ensure not alone; mother to stay with patient and call 999

facts.content: After emergency department care, the patient is to contact the clinic to arrange emergency allergy injections (autoinjector) and further management.
facts.source_text: • Post-ED: patient to contact clinic to arrange emergency allergy injections (autoinjector) and further management
